propositions: Three pure filesystem primitives currently defined in fsck_repair.py have no functional relationship to repair logic but are imported by seven production modules, creating an inverted dependency
Moving _resolve_tracker_git_dir, _ticket_dirs, and _dir_is_archived from fsck_repair.py to gitutil.py eliminates the architectural inversion while preserving gitutil as a stdlib-only leaf module

fsck.py must continue re-exporting the moved primitives and fsck_repair.py must maintain module-level bindings to these names to preserve compatibility with existing test patches that monkeypatch these module attributes

Function-local importers (compact.py, bridge_repair.py, tracker_maintenance.py) must be repointed to import directly from gitutil rather than from fsck_repair to remove the inverted dependency completely
The move requires no changes to test files and introduces no circular imports, verified by the twelve acceptance criteria including module-size caps, gate runs, and full test suite execution
